snippet.title: Season 5: A Grim Doctrine Launch Trailer | Overwatch
snippet.description:
Something truly wicked is being unleashed during Season 5: A Grim Doctrine.

The wait is over! Our newest Support Hero is here with the arrival of Doctrine. Freed from his volcanic prison by Doomfist himself, this sinister foe can manipulate life using his Eternal Scepter and mechanical drones, while also empowering each ability with his signature Infuse.

Break into Watchpoint: Grímsvötn - the Icelandic prison that once held Doctrine and Doomfist, and our first new Escort Map since Overwatch 2 launched. Battle your way through fire and ice as the final chapter in the Reign of Talon starts right here.

The Halloween mayhem continues this year with our newest event, Mystery Madness: Graveyard Games. You’ll start off as a random Hero and unlock random new powers each time you die. Complete chilling challenges to collect Offerings and help summon the next Hero into the madness.

Unlock haunting new cosmetics through the Season 5 Ultimate Battle Pass, Starter Pack, and in the Shop like Dokiwatch 2.0, our latest collaboration, and new Mythic skin for Wuyang and Mythic weapon skin for Lúcio.

If you thought you knew Sombra and Roadhog before, get ready to think again. Sombra is hacking her way into the Support role, while Roadhog changes things up with a revamped Scrap Gun and all-new Trash Compactor ability.

And that's just the beginning! Look out for Drives coming to Quick Play, Unvaulted Battle Passes, and so much more all season long.

Sink your teeth in when Season 5: A Grim Doctrine launches in-game TOMORROW at 11am PT.

Overwatch is free to play on PC and console, including Nintendo Switch™ 2!

Videoclip oficial de la canción de Maki "QUISIERA PARAR EL TIEMPO 2" junto a Andy & María Artés.

Se cumplen 10 AÑOS del nacimiento de un HIMNO. El 24 de septiembre de 2016 nació QUISIERA PARAR EL TIEMPO, canción dedicada por MAKI en su boda a MARÍA ARTÉS y que se convirtió en un canto al amor. Posteriormente millones de parejas por todo el mundo la han hecho suya. Ahora llega QUISIERA PARAR EL TIEMPO 2, una nueva versión homenaje con nueva producción a cargo de Baghira & Dr. NeoCórtex junto a Maki & María, y revisada en letra por ambos. 

Además, en este caso, interpretada junto a María Artés y ANDY, que inicia su carrera en solitario tras sus años de éxito con Andy & Lucas. Y es que 10 años dan para mucho, y Maki & María se han convertido en referentes del Flamenco Pop asentando este estilo tanto en nuestro país como en Latinoamérica. Y eso merece una celebración especial por estos 20 años: 20 CONMIGO.

snippet.title: GRIEF (VERIFIED) // TOP 1
snippet.description:
One level. 2 years, 436K attempts, ~600 hours of playtime, and a dream.

Icedcave first approached me with the concept of GRIEF in 2021, when Slaughterhouse was the brand new #1 demon. GRIEF was his final attempt at giving life to the level that launched his name into the community back in 2015 - Old Slaughterhouse. I saw what he was doing, I saw his vision and passion, and I knew this would be something big. I had always wanted to verify the hardest level in GD, and once I laid eyes on GRIEF I knew this was the one. I asked Icedcave for permission to verify it, and thankfully he accepted. 

Over the next 2 years, I followed the building process of GRIEF, going from a layout that garnered tons of hate, to the final showcase which became the beloved level we all recognize today. Every step of the way, this verification was something to look forward to in my career - until it wasn't.

May 1st, 2024 - The First Day. I started up Stream 1 of GRIEF filled with hope and ambition. I knew this was going to be my longest journey, but I was ready for anything. At the time, the mechanical skill required to play GRIEF's gameplay was barely conceivable on its own, let alone for a 3 minute long level. By the end of the first month, I only just started to get a grasp of the level, getting it in 3 runs - 27%, 25-66, and 65-100. I would make steady progress over the following months, getting all the way to 80% in November, just 6 months after starting the verification. We are still in the year 2024 and the path to completion looked quite clear, so you may be wondering what the hell happened since then.  

GREAFER - This part stretches from 65% - 75%. Despite only being 10 seconds long, it carries the most significant weight of GRIEF's difficulty. You are already under the pressure of 2 minutes of gameplay being behind you, and now you must maneuver through incredibly precise wave patterns at 4X speed maxing out at 8 CPS, all while barely being able to see anything. There's not enough characters available in this description to adequately describe how hard this part was from 0 for me, and it was something even I didn't fully understand when I got there for the first time. 

Mindblock - When you fail at something over and over again, it becomes progressively more of a mental fault than a physical one. You're conditioned to believe that you will continue to fail, and it becomes hell to escape. With no time to breathe, Greafer became that hell. I died at this part over 60 times before passing 80%. Everyone that has followed this verification knows that 80% was the most devious mindblock in the whole game, and I truly don't wish that on anyone. It started to become a matter of "if" I could even beat GRIEF rather than "when". For the majority of 2025, I was in a state of limbo with this level, feeling like I was falling behind too fast to keep up. It made playing even harder, and my mindset needed to change.

83% - On November 1st, 2025, I finally broke the curse of 80%. This extra 3% meant everything to me at the time. It almost felt like I had verified a new top 1. This was probably the most defining turning point of the verification, as I had passed almost all of the difficulty in GRIEF. At 82%, the timings settle down in terms of precision after the hell of 79-81. This 3 second wave part, named Tacos, is why It took 6 months to get a new best of 84%, but even that felt like lightning speed compared to what I was used to.

We are now in 2026, and only now was I finally able to handle the pressure of playing Greafer and Tacos from 0%. The path to completion looked clear, for real this time. In June, I got a heartbreaking fail of 97%, but me and everyone else knew this was finally going to be done soon. Over these last few months I gave GRIEF everything I had in me. I poured in more hours than ever, and played more consistently than ever. I was always determined, but something was different now. The light at the end of the tunnel wasn't just an illusion. 

Ever since the beginning, my #1 goal for GRIEF was to make it as hard as a level could be for me - no compromises. After all this time, I'm proud to say I succeeded. GRIEF is the hardest thing I will ever do. To those out there who have something to chase, take this as motivation to never give up on your dreams.

Thank you, TCD 
Thank you, Icedcave
Thank you, renavelvet
Thank you, mom and dad
and thank you to all of you that were here for me. This journey was for us.
